# gitea_repository_issue_config (Data Source)

Fetches the parsed issue configuration for a repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_issue_config" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.

### Read-Only

- `blank_issues_enabled` (Boolean) Whether blank issues are allowed.
- `contact_links` (List of Object) Configured contact links. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact_links))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `valid` (Boolean) Whether the repository issue config validates.
- `validation_message` (String) Validation details returned by Gitea.

<a id="nestedatt--contact_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contact_links`

Read-Only:

- `about` (String)
- `name` (String)
